prefs.a11y.announce.check: Announce when background work finishes or fails
prefs.a11y.announce.help: Read by screen readers such as NVDA, Narrator and VoiceOver.
prefs.a11y.announce.label: Announcements
prefs.a11y.blink.help: The cursor in text fields. The terminal's never blinks.
prefs.a11y.blink.label: Blinking cursor
prefs.a11y.colors.help: Branches, diffs and file status use colors that stay apart with color blindness.
prefs.a11y.colors.label: Colors
prefs.a11y.contrast.follow: Also when the system uses high contrast
prefs.a11y.contrast.help: Switches to High contrast dark or light; turning it off brings back your theme.
prefs.a11y.contrast.label: High contrast
prefs.a11y.diff_size.label: Diff text size
prefs.a11y.focus.help: Strong draws a thicker ring with an outline that shows on every color.
prefs.a11y.focus.label: Focus indicator
prefs.a11y.reduce_motion.follow: Also when the system asks for less motion
prefs.a11y.reduce_motion.help: Tooltips and popups appear without fading or sliding in.
prefs.a11y.reduce_motion.label: Reduce motion
prefs.a11y.shortcuts.help: Every command can be given a key.
prefs.a11y.shortcuts.label: Shortcuts
prefs.a11y.terminal_size.label: Terminal text size
prefs.a11y.toast_time.help: A notification you point at or focus stays open. Failures with Fix or Details stay until you close them.
prefs.a11y.toast_time.label: Notifications stay
prefs.a11y.tooltip_delay.label: Tooltip delay
prefs.a11y.zoom.follow: Also follow the system's text size
prefs.a11y.zoom.help: Scales all text and controls. {in} and {out} also change it.
prefs.a11y.zoom.label: Interface size
prefs.editor.font_size.help: The size of the text in the diff viewer: hunks, the whole-file view and file history. The default is 12.5.
prefs.editor.font_size.label: Font size
prefs.editor.history_pane.help: Whether file and folder histories open on the commit's changes (Diff) or the whole file as of the commit (File). The history header's toggle changes it too.
prefs.editor.history_pane.label: File history shows
prefs.editor.history_preview.check: Show them rendered in file history
prefs.editor.history_preview.help: Whether the file history's File view shows Markdown files rendered or as their text. The Text | Preview switch above the file changes it too.
prefs.editor.history_preview.label: Markdown files
prefs.editor.line_numbers.check: Show old and new line numbers
prefs.editor.line_numbers.help: The old and new line numbers beside each line in the inline, split and whole-file views.
prefs.editor.line_numbers.label: Line numbers
prefs.editor.reset.label: Diff viewer settings
prefs.editor.svg_preview.check: Show them drawn in the diff viewer
prefs.editor.svg_preview.help: Whether the diff viewer shows a changed SVG file drawn or as its text. The Text | Preview switch above the diff changes it too.
prefs.editor.svg_preview.label: SVG files
prefs.editor.syntax.help: Colors code in the diff viewer by its language, worked out from the file name or, for scripts, the first line. Diffs with more than 2,000 lines or 100 KB of text, or with very long lines, are shown without colors.
prefs.editor.syntax.label: Syntax highlighting
prefs.editor.tab_size.help: Tabs in diff lines stop at every N columns. Only the display changes; files are never changed.
prefs.editor.tab_size.label: Tab size
prefs.editor.word_highlights.help: Marks the words that changed between a removed line and the added line paired with it.
prefs.editor.word_highlights.label: Word highlights
prefs.editor.wrap.help: Long lines in the diff viewer (hunks, the whole-file view and file history) continue on the next line instead of running past the right edge. The diff header has the same toggle.
prefs.editor.wrap.label: Long lines
prefs.general.auto_fetch.help: How many minutes Glowfly waits between background fetches of every remote of the open repository, from 1 to 60. 0 turns background fetching off.
prefs.general.auto_fetch.help_lfs: In repositories that store files in Git LFS, it also downloads the LFS files of the checked-out commit.
prefs.general.auto_fetch.label: Auto-fetch interval
prefs.general.auto_fetch.warn: Each fetch contacts every remote, so short intervals add up when there are many.
prefs.general.auto_prune.check: Remove remote-tracking branches that no longer exist on the remote when fetching
prefs.general.auto_prune.label: Auto-prune
prefs.general.auto_stash.check: Always stash before checkout, pull, merge, rebase, cherry-pick and revert
prefs.general.auto_stash.help: Glowfly stashes your changes, runs the operation and puts them back when it ends. Off, it asks each time. A hard reset always asks.
prefs.general.auto_stash.label: Uncommitted changes
prefs.general.autocrlf.help: Sets core.autocrlf in your global Git config: how line endings are converted between your files and commits.
prefs.general.autocrlf.input: input: commit LF, check out as is
prefs.general.autocrlf.label: Line endings
prefs.general.autocrlf.true: true: check out CRLF, commit LF
prefs.general.conflict_check.check: Check the current branch for conflicts with its upstream or default branch
prefs.general.conflict_check.help: Runs after each refresh and fetch with git merge-tree, without touching your files. Needs Git 2.38 or newer. Branch menus can still check on demand when this is off.
prefs.general.conflict_check.label: Conflict check
prefs.general.default_branch.help: Suggested as the first branch's name when you create a repository. You can still change it each time.
prefs.general.default_branch.label: Default branch name
prefs.general.delete_to_trash.check_othe: Move deleted files to the Trash
prefs.general.delete_to_trash.check_wind: Move deleted files to the Recycle Bin
prefs.general.delete_to_trash.help: When off, Delete… and discarding an untracked file remove it from disk straight away, and it can't be recovered.
prefs.general.delete_to_trash.label: Deleting files
prefs.general.extended_logging.check: Add the Git commands Glowfly runs, with their timings, to the activity log
prefs.general.extended_logging.help: Also writes Glowfly's informational and debug messages to the error log. Leave it off unless you're tracking down a problem: it adds a line for every Git command, background refreshes included.
prefs.general.extended_logging.label: Extended logging
prefs.general.forget.confirm_title: Sign out of Git Credential Manager
prefs.general.forget.connections.one: Disconnects {count} integration and deletes its saved token. The second button also signs Git Credential Manager out of that host.
prefs.general.forget.connections.other: Disconnects {count} integrations and deletes their saved tokens. The second button also signs Git Credential Manager out of those hosts.
prefs.general.forget.gcm_body.one: This disconnects every integration and also removes the sign-in Git Credential Manager stored for {count} host. Pushes and pulls to that host will ask you to sign in again.
prefs.general.forget.gcm_body.other: This disconnects every integration and also removes the sign-ins Git Credential Manager stored for {count} hosts. Pushes and pulls to those hosts will ask you to sign in again.
prefs.general.forget.gcm_button: Also sign out of Git Credential Manager
prefs.general.forget.label: Saved connections
prefs.general.forget.none: Glowfly has no stored connections to remove.
prefs.general.frame_times.check: Show how long each frame takes, in a corner of the window
prefs.general.frame_times.help: The last, average and slowest of the recent frames, in milliseconds, for tracking down a slow window. Frames of 50 ms or more go to the performance log either way.
prefs.general.frame_times.label: Frame times
prefs.general.git.help: The Git program Glowfly runs for commits, fetches, pushes and hooks (Preferences > Git).
prefs.general.git.label: Git program
prefs.general.index_history.check: Index large repositories in the background so search and Filter cover every commit
prefs.general.index_history.help: Uses about 300 bytes of memory per commit while the repository is open. When off, search covers the loaded commits and loads older ones as it needs them.
prefs.general.index_history.label: Search the whole history
prefs.general.initial_commits.help: Minimum 500. The graph loads this many when it next refreshes.
prefs.general.initial_commits.label: Initial commits in graph
prefs.general.initial_commits.warn: Higher numbers make the graph slower to load.
prefs.general.language.help: Menus, buttons and messages are shown in this language. Parts of Glowfly that aren't translated yet stay in English.
prefs.general.language.label: Language
prefs.general.load_more.check: Load more commits when you scroll near the end of the graph
prefs.general.load_more.help: When off, only the graph's Load more link adds commits past the limit.
prefs.general.load_more.label: Load more while scrolling
prefs.general.logs.help: activity.jsonl keeps the activity log across sessions, errors.log holds warnings, errors and crashes, and performance.log lists operations that took half a second or more.
prefs.general.logs.label: Logs
prefs.general.longpaths.help: Turns on core.longpaths in your global Git config. Git for Windows needs it for files whose full path is over 260 characters; macOS and Linux have no such limit.
prefs.general.longpaths.label: Long paths
prefs.general.remember_sign_ins.check: Remember HTTPS sign-ins typed in Glowfly
prefs.general.remember_sign_ins.help: Once Git accepts a username and password or token typed in Glowfly, it is saved with Git's credential helper. With no helper set up, Glowfly sets up the system's credential store for Git. On Linux without a keyring helper, Git's in-memory cache keeps them for 15 minutes after each use instead.
prefs.general.remember_sign_ins.label: Remember sign-ins
prefs.general.reopen.check: Reopen the tabs from last time when Glowfly starts
prefs.general.reopen.label: Reopen last repository
prefs.general.submodules.check: Update submodules after checkouts, pulls, merges, rebases and resets
prefs.general.submodules.help: Runs git submodule update --init --recursive when one of these succeeds, leaving out any submodule where that would strand commits that no branch or tag contains. A repository can override this in its SUBMODULES section menu.
prefs.general.submodules.label: Submodules
prefs.general.tips.help: One short tip at a time, in the place it's about. Nothing is collected or sent.
prefs.general.tips.label: Tips
prefs.general.tips_again.help: Tips you dismissed, and the one-time notes, show again.
prefs.general.tips_again.label: Seen tips
prefs.general.updates.check: Check for updates once a day
prefs.general.updates.help: Glowfly asks GitHub's releases API for the newest release of its repository once a day. GitHub sees your IP address and Glowfly's version, nothing about your repositories. Downloads are checked against the release's published SHA-256 checksums. Glowfly's builds aren't code-signed yet, so this confirms a download matches what the release published, not who published it.
prefs.general.updates.label: Updates
prefs.general.updates.open_quit_deb.help: Glowfly opens the package in your software installer and quits. Start Glowfly again once it is installed.
prefs.general.updates.open_quit_dmg.help: Glowfly opens the disk image and quits. Drag Glowfly to Applications to replace this copy, then open it again.
prefs.general.updates.open_quit_msi.help: This copy wasn't installed with the MSI, so Glowfly opens the installer and quits. The installed copy appears in the Start menu.
prefs.general.updates.show_only.help: This copy was installed with a package, so replace it with the downloaded file by hand.
prefs.general.updates.whats_new.chip: Show “What's new” in the status bar
prefs.general.updates.whats_new.label: After an update:
prefs.general.watch_files.check: Refresh the working tree as soon as files change outside Glowfly
prefs.general.watch_files.help_key: When off, Glowfly refreshes when its window regains focus or you press {key}.
prefs.general.watch_files.help_no_key: When off, Glowfly refreshes when its window regains focus or you choose Refresh.
prefs.general.watch_files.label: Watch for file changes
prefs.git_program.help: Glowfly runs this Git for commits, fetches, pushes, hooks and signing. The built-in terminal and external tools still use whatever Git your PATH finds.
prefs.git_program.old.warn: Some features need Git {version} or newer: {features}.
prefs.git_program.older.warn: Older than {version}, so these will be off: {features}.
prefs.git_program.version.label: Version
prefs.hooks.monitor.label: File system monitor
prefs.hooks.monitor.off.done: Git's file system monitor is off for this repository.
prefs.hooks.monitor.off.failed: Git's file system monitor couldn't be turned off. The activity log shows what Git said.
prefs.hooks.monitor.off.help: Git's built-in file system monitor can make reading this repository's changes faster. It is a small Git process that keeps running in the background. Turn on starts it and sets core.fsmonitor.
prefs.hooks.monitor.off.job: Turn off the file system monitor
prefs.hooks.monitor.on.help: Git's built-in file system monitor watches this repository in the background, so reading its changes is faster. Turn off stops it and unsets core.fsmonitor.
prefs.identity.email.help: Overrides your profile for this repository only (local Git config). Leave empty to use your profile.
prefs.identity.email.label: Email
prefs.identity.intro.none: This repository has no commit identity yet. Set a name and email below, or in a profile.
prefs.identity.intro.profile: This repository commits as {name} <{email}> from profile {profile}.
prefs.identity.name.label: Name
prefs.links.flatpak_note: Flatpak registers glowfly:// links for Glowfly when it is installed.
prefs.links.help: Lets links from a browser or chat open a repository, branch, commit or tag in Glowfly. Only your user account is affected.
prefs.links.label: Glowfly links
prefs.links.macos_note: On macOS, links will open Glowfly once it is installed as an application.
prefs.links.status.registered: glowfly:// links open this copy of Glowfly
prefs.nav.caption: Preferences
prefs.profile.env.author_email.warn: {var} is set in Glowfly's environment, so commits take the author email {value} from it instead of your Git config.
prefs.profile.env.author_name.warn: {var} is set in Glowfly's environment, so commits take the author name {value} from it instead of your Git config.
prefs.profile.env.committer_email.warn: {var} is set in Glowfly's environment, so commits take the committer email {value} from it instead of your Git config.
prefs.profile.env.committer_name.warn: {var} is set in Glowfly's environment, so commits take the committer name {value} from it instead of your Git config.
prefs.profile.env.empty_name.warn: {var} is set but empty in Glowfly's environment, and Git won't commit with an empty name. Unset it or give it a name, then start Glowfly again.
prefs.profiles.intro: A profile is a name, email and settings that switch together by folder.
prefs.save_bar.first: Save or revert your changes first.
prefs.signing.copy_public_key.done: Public key copied to the clipboard
prefs.signing.copy_public_key.failed: Could not export the public key: {why}
prefs.signing.expired.warn: This key has expired, so Git can't sign new commits with it.
prefs.signing.extend.by_hand.link: How to extend it by hand
prefs.signing.extend.done: Extended {key} by 2 years. Copy the public key to your Git host again so it sees the new date.
prefs.signing.generate.done: Created GPG key {id} and set it as your signing key
prefs.signing.generate.failed: Could not generate a GPG key: {why}
prefs.signing.revoked.warn: This key has been revoked, so Git can't sign new commits with it. Generate a new key below.
prefs.ssh.agent.no_auth_sock.warn: SSH_AUTH_SOCK isn't set in Glowfly's environment; start ssh-agent in your login session.
prefs.ssh.agent.no_ssh_add.warn: ssh-add wasn't found. Install OpenSSH (or Git for Windows) and reload.
prefs.ssh.agent.pageant.help: Pageant is running. Add keys in Pageant; ssh-add can't reach it.
prefs.ssh.agent.pill.off.tip: No SSH agent is running, and nothing points at one.
prefs.ssh.agent.pill.unreachable.tip: ssh-add is missing or failed, or something points at an SSH agent that didn't answer.
prefs.ssh.agent.service.disabled.help: The OpenSSH Authentication Agent service is disabled (an administrator can enable it in Services)
prefs.ssh.agent.service.missing.help: The OpenSSH Authentication Agent service isn't installed
prefs.ssh.agent.service.running.help: The OpenSSH Authentication Agent service is running
prefs.ssh.agent.service.stopped.help: The OpenSSH Authentication Agent service is stopped
prefs.ssh.agent.title: Agent
prefs.ssh.agent.use.help: ssh gets keys from your running agent. Glowfly doesn't choose a key in core.sshCommand while this is on.
prefs.ssh.agent_only.copy_failed.toast: The agent didn't give this key's public key, so nothing was copied.
prefs.ssh.agent_only.no_public.tip: The agent didn't give this key's public key.
prefs.ssh.agent_only.title: Only in the agent
prefs.ssh.card.add_agent.busy.tip: A key is being added to the agent.
prefs.ssh.card.add_agent.checking.tip: Wait until the agent has been checked.
prefs.ssh.card.add_agent.job.tip: Wait until {job} finishes: its credential prompts would mix with ssh-add's.
prefs.ssh.card.forget.tip: Glowfly forgets this key; its files stay where they are.
prefs.ssh.card.no_services.help: Connect a service in Integrations first
prefs.ssh.config.reason.host_token: depends on the host it connects to ({token})
prefs.ssh.config.reason.not_a_key: its .pub doesn't start with a public key line
prefs.ssh.config.reason.other_user: is in another user's home folder
prefs.ssh.config.reason.public_only: only {file}.pub is there; ssh uses it to pick that key from the agent
prefs.ssh.config.reason.relative: is relative to the folder ssh runs in
prefs.ssh.config.reason.unsupported: uses {token}, which Glowfly can't fill in
prefs.ssh.config.reason.variable: uses the variable {name}, which isn't set
prefs.ssh.generate.comment.control.warn: The comment can't contain line breaks or control characters.
prefs.ssh.generate.comment.help: Stored in the public key to tell keys apart; usually your email. Empty uses ssh-keygen's default (user@host).
prefs.ssh.generate.comment.label: Comment
prefs.ssh.generate.confirm.label: Confirm passphrase
prefs.ssh.generate.location.empty.warn: Enter where to save the private key.
prefs.ssh.generate.location.folder.warn: Enter a file name, not a folder.
prefs.ssh.generate.location.label: Save location
prefs.ssh.generate.location.public.warn: Enter the private key's path; the public key is saved next to it with .pub added.
prefs.ssh.generate.location.relative.war: Enter a full path, such as ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_work.
prefs.ssh.generate.location.taken.warn: A key already exists here; Generate key will ask before replacing it.
prefs.ssh.generate.location.windows_name: Windows can't use that file name: no device name such as CON or NUL, none of < > : " | ? *, and no dot or space at the end.
prefs.ssh.generate.passphrase.help: Encrypts the private key; ssh asks for it, or your SSH agent remembers it, when the key is used.
prefs.ssh.generate.passphrase.label: Passphrase
prefs.ssh.generate.reading.warn: Wait until your .ssh folder has been read.
prefs.ssh.generate.subtitle: Creates an Ed25519 key pair with ssh-keygen.
prefs.ssh.generate.title: Generate SSH key
prefs.ssh.keys.empty: No key pairs in {dir} yet. Generate one, or use one you already have.
prefs.ssh.keys.error.label: Couldn't read your SSH keys
prefs.ssh.keys.help: Key pairs in {dir} that have a matching .pub file, the ones {config} names, and keys you added with Use existing. ssh and Git use them to reach SSH remotes.
prefs.ssh.keys.no_keygen.warn: ssh-keygen wasn't found, so fingerprints aren't shown and keys can't be generated. Install OpenSSH (or Git for Windows) and reload.
prefs.ssh.keys.pick.no_public.warn: {file} has no {file}.pub next to it. Recreate it with ssh-keygen -y -f {file} > {file}.pub, then add the key again.
prefs.ssh.keys.pick.not_a_file.warn: {file} isn't a file. Choose the private key itself.
prefs.ssh.keys.pick.not_a_key.warn: {file}.pub doesn't start with a public key line, so {file} can't be listed.
prefs.ssh.keys.pick.title: Choose a private key
prefs.ssh.keys.title: Keys
prefs.ssh.keys.use_existing.tip: Add a key pair from another folder to this list. Glowfly remembers where it is and never copies or moves it.
prefs.ssh.mark.agent.tip: The running SSH agent holds this key.
prefs.ssh.mark.agent_only.tip: The agent holds this key, but no key file for it is listed. Git can still use it through the agent.
prefs.ssh.mark.default.tip: core.sshCommand uses this key for all repositories.
prefs.ssh.mark.repo.tip: The core.sshCommand of {repo} uses this key.
prefs.ssh.mark.tried.tip: Nothing is chosen for all repositories, and ssh tries keys with this name on its own.
prefs.ssh.service.fallback.warn: {service} didn't let Glowfly add keys with this sign-in (it needs permission to write SSH keys). The key is copied; paste it on the page that opened.
prefs.ssh.service.heading: Add {file} to {service} ({host})
prefs.ssh.service.title.control.warn: The title can't contain line breaks or control characters.
prefs.ssh.service.title.label: Title
prefs.ssh.which.agent_on.help: Turn off Use local SSH agent (in Agent) to choose a key.
prefs.ssh.which.agent_on.tip: Turn off Use local SSH agent to choose a key
prefs.ssh.which.all.label: All repositories
prefs.ssh.which.git_ssh_command.warn: GIT_SSH_COMMAND is set in Glowfly's environment: it overrides core.sshCommand for every Git command Glowfly runs.
prefs.ssh.which.help: Glowfly writes the chosen key into core.sshCommand. Let ssh decide leaves it unset, so ssh uses its config, the agent or its default key names.
prefs.ssh.which.not_trusted.help: Trust this repository first: a key setting in its own config makes Git run ssh with it.
prefs.ssh.which.not_trusted.tip: Trust this repository first: a key setting in its own config makes Git run ssh with it, so Glowfly would ask about trusting it.
prefs.ssh.which.other_agent.help: Git runs this command instead of plain ssh; it may not use the agent.
prefs.ssh.which.overrides.help: The {repo} setting overrides the one for all repositories in this repository.
prefs.ssh.which.reading.tip: Wait until core.sshCommand has been read.
prefs.ssh.which.repo.label: {repo} only
prefs.ssh.which.repo_changed.tip: Another repository is open now; reload this page.
prefs.ssh.which.title: Which key
prefs.ssh.windows.already.help: Git already runs Windows' OpenSSH, which reads keys from the agent service.
prefs.ssh.windows.blocked.key.tip: A key is chosen for all repositories. Choose Let ssh decide in Which key first.
prefs.ssh.windows.blocked.other.tip: core.sshCommand for all repositories is set outside Glowfly. Choose Let ssh decide in Which key first.
prefs.ssh.windows.bundled.help: Git runs Git for Windows' own ssh ({path}), which doesn't read keys from the agent service.
prefs.ssh.windows.off.toast: Git runs Git for Windows' own ssh again
prefs.ssh.windows.old.warn: Windows' OpenSSH {version} is older than 8.4: passphrase and host-key prompts may not reach Glowfly.
prefs.ssh.windows.on.help: Git runs Windows' OpenSSH ({path}) for all repositories, so ssh reads keys from the agent service.
prefs.ssh.windows.on.toast: Git now runs Windows' OpenSSH for SSH remotes
prefs.ssh.windows.service_off.help: The agent service isn't running, so ssh finds no keys in it.
prefs.ssh.windows.unavailable.tip: Not available now: Git doesn't run Git for Windows' own ssh with the agent service running.
prefs.ssh.windows.use.tip: Sets core.sshCommand for all repositories to {path}.
prefs.terminal.args.help: Separated by spaces; put an argument that contains spaces in double quotes.
prefs.terminal.args.label: Shell arguments
prefs.terminal.colours.hard_to_read: Hard to read on this background: {colours}.
prefs.terminal.colours.help: The terminal's background, text, cursor, selection and 16 basic colors. Match app theme uses the theme's own (a theme file can set them with its terminal_ keys). Import scheme… reads a Windows Terminal scheme or settings.json, or an iTerm2 .itermcolors file, into the themes folder's terminal folder; colors a scheme leaves out come from the app theme.
prefs.terminal.colours.label: Colors
prefs.terminal.colours.not_in_folder: {file} is not in the themes folder's terminal folder; using the app theme's colors.
prefs.terminal.copy_on_select.check: Copy selected text to the clipboard
prefs.terminal.copy_on_select.help: Selecting text with the mouse copies it to the clipboard. The copy shortcut then goes to the shell instead.
prefs.terminal.copy_on_select.label: Copy on select
prefs.terminal.cursor.help: How the cursor is drawn. It is fainter while the terminal doesn't have the keyboard.
prefs.terminal.cursor.label: Cursor style
prefs.terminal.dim.check: Dim the terminal while you work elsewhere
prefs.terminal.dim.help: Shade the terminal while another part of the window has the keyboard.
prefs.terminal.dim.label: Dim when unfocused
prefs.terminal.font_size.help: The size of the terminal's text. The default is 12.5.
prefs.terminal.font_size.label: Font size
prefs.terminal.middle_click.check: Paste the selection with a middle click
prefs.terminal.middle_click.help: A middle click on the terminal pastes the text last selected in any program (the primary selection) into the shell.
prefs.terminal.middle_click.label: Middle-click paste
prefs.terminal.open_in_panel.check: Open a tab in the built-in terminal
prefs.terminal.open_in_panel.help: Open in terminal (in the command palette, and when right-clicking the toolbar's Terminal button) starts a new tab in the terminal panel instead of an external terminal.
prefs.terminal.open_in_panel.label: Open in terminal
prefs.terminal.option_meta.check: Use Option as the Meta key
prefs.terminal.option_meta.help: Option with a letter, digit or punctuation key sends Esc and that key, so the shell's Meta shortcuts work (such as moving by word). Option then no longer types special characters in the terminal.
prefs.terminal.option_meta.label: Option as Meta
prefs.terminal.program.label: Shell program
prefs.terminal.reset.label: Terminal settings
prefs.terminal.shell.help_unix: Automatic starts your login shell ($SHELL), else /bin/sh. The shell applies to terminals started after a change; running ones keep theirs.
prefs.terminal.shell.help_windows: Automatic starts PowerShell 7 when it is installed, else Windows PowerShell, else the Command Prompt. The shell applies to terminals started after a change; running ones keep theirs.
prefs.terminal.shell.label: Default shell
prefs.tools.arguments.label: Arguments
prefs.tools.bundle_warn: An application bundle opens files, but extra options may be dropped. Choosing the program's command-line tool works best.
prefs.tools.diff.git_tool: Empty, so Git config's diff tool is used: {name} (from {key}).
prefs.tools.diff.help: The program that compares two versions of a file. Leave it empty to use the diff tool Git config names (diff.tool), if any.
prefs.tools.diff.label: Diff tool executable
prefs.tools.diff_args.label: Diff tool arguments
prefs.tools.diff_help: {local} is the older version and {remote} the newer one. For unstaged changes {remote} is the working file itself, so edits saved there are kept. Every other version is a read-only copy in a temporary folder. {path} is the file's full path in the working tree (it may not exist there) and {repo} is the repository folder. Double quotes keep text with spaces together, and the arguments go straight to the program, without a shell.
prefs.tools.editor.help: The program Glowfly starts to open files and repositories. Leave it empty for none.
prefs.tools.editor.label: Editor executable
prefs.tools.editor_file_args.label: Open file arguments
prefs.tools.editor_repo_args.label: Open repository arguments
prefs.tools.git_tool.builtin: A tool Git knows: Glowfly runs git {command} --tool={name}.
prefs.tools.git_tool.builtin_path: A tool Git knows: Glowfly runs git {command} --tool={name}, which starts {path}.
prefs.tools.git_tool.repo_command: This command comes from the repository's own config: it runs only once you trust the repository.
prefs.tools.git_tool.repo_git: git {command} runs Git in this repository: it runs only once you trust the repository.
prefs.tools.git_tool.unknown: Git config sets no {keys} and Git has no built-in tool called {name}, so it can't be used.
prefs.tools.merge.git_tool: Empty, so Git config's merge tool is used: {name} (from {key}).
prefs.tools.merge.help: The program that resolves a conflicted file. Leave it empty to use the merge tool Git config names (merge.tool), if any.
prefs.tools.merge.label: Merge tool executable
prefs.tools.merge_args.label: Merge tool arguments
prefs.tools.merge_help: {base} is the common ancestor (an empty file when both sides added the file), {ours} is your side, {theirs} is the side being merged in, {output} is the working file the result is saved to, and {repo} is the repository folder. Glowfly waits until the program exits, so a program that hands off to a window that is already open needs its wait option. Console programs aren't supported.
prefs.tools.placeholder_help: {path} is the file's full path, {line} its line number (1 when no line is chosen) and {repo} the repository folder. Double quotes keep text with spaces together; there is no escape character, so backslashes in Windows paths are fine. The arguments go straight to the program, without a shell.
prefs.tools.program_hint: Program name on your PATH, or a full path
prefs.tools.terminal.help: Used when Open in terminal doesn't open a built-in tab. Leave it empty to use the system's usual terminal; when set, this program starts in the repository folder.
prefs.tools.terminal.label: Terminal executable
prefs.tools.terminal_args.help: {repo} is the repository folder; the program also starts in that folder.
prefs.tools.terminal_args.label: Terminal arguments
prefs.tools.warn.missing: {placeholder} is missing, so the tool won't be given that version.
prefs.tools.warn.not_placeholder: {placeholder} is not a placeholder; it is passed as typed.
prefs.tools.warn.unmatched_quote: These arguments have an unmatched quote; they can't be used until it is fixed.
prefs.tracker.year_branches.check: Read a year at the start of a branch name as an issue number
prefs.tracker.year_branches.help: Off: a branch like 2024-cleanup links no issue, while 123-fix still links #123. Names like issue-2024, gh-2024 or #2024 link the issue either way.
prefs.tracker.year_branches.label: Branch names
prefs.ui.avatars.help: Sends a hash of each author's email to Gravatar, only for repositories on github.com, gitlab.com, bitbucket.org or codeberg.org.
prefs.ui.avatars.label: Author pictures
prefs.ui.behind_alerts.check: Say when the branch falls behind its upstream
prefs.ui.behind_alerts.help: After a background fetch, say when the checked-out branch has fallen behind its upstream, with a button to pull.
prefs.ui.behind_alerts.label: Behind alerts
prefs.ui.branch_visibility.help: Relevant branches keeps the graph to the checked-out branch, its upstream, the default branch and branches with an open pull request.
prefs.ui.branch_visibility.label: Branch visibility
prefs.ui.columns.help: Either reset also puts every column back to its standard width. To resize a column, drag the divider beside its title in the graph header; double-click a divider to reset just that column.
prefs.ui.columns.label: Column layout
prefs.ui.confirm_push_pull.help: A short notification says what each push or pull did, such as “Pushed 2 commits to origin/main.”
prefs.ui.confirm_push_pull.label: Push and pull
prefs.ui.date_format.label: Date format
prefs.ui.date_locale.label: Date/time locale
prefs.ui.date_time.patterns_help: Patterns use moment.js tokens: YYYY, MM, MMMM, DD, D, dddd, HH, h, mm, ss, A. Text in [brackets] is literal. Leave a field blank to follow the locale's usual format.
prefs.ui.date_time_format.label: Date and time format
prefs.ui.desktop_notifications.check: Show system notifications while Glowfly is in the background
prefs.ui.desktop_notifications.help: Finished jobs and behind alerts also appear as desktop notifications when Glowfly's window isn't focused. Background fetches stay quiet. Turning this on sends one notification so you can check that they reach you.
prefs.ui.desktop_notifications.label: Desktop notifications
prefs.ui.details_panel.label: Commit details panel
prefs.ui.file_lists.help: Whether changed-file lists show each path on its own row or grouped in folders. The toggle in a list's header changes it too.
prefs.ui.file_lists.label: Changed files
prefs.ui.full_date_format.label: Full date and time format
prefs.ui.ghost.check: Show a New branch button on the checked-out commit
prefs.ui.ghost.help: While you point at the checked-out commit, or it is the selected commit, a quiet New branch… button follows its branch labels; click it to start a branch from the current one. For any other commit, use New branch here… in its right-click menu.
prefs.ui.ghost.label: Quick-branch button
prefs.ui.graph.changes.help: Lines added and removed per commit, computed in the background.
prefs.ui.graph.columns.label: Graph columns
prefs.ui.graph.density.compact.tip: 28 px rows, to see more history at once
prefs.ui.graph.density.label: Row density
prefs.ui.graph.description.label: Commit description
prefs.ui.group_colour.help: Next unused color gives each new group a color no other group has yet, until all eight are taken. To recolor the groups you already have, choose Reset all group colors in a group's menu on the start page.
prefs.ui.group_colour.label: New group color
prefs.ui.group_tabs.check: Keep a repository's worktree tabs side by side
prefs.ui.group_tabs.help: Tabs for worktrees of the same repository (its main folder and every linked worktree) stay next to each other, with a colored line under them. Drag a tab inside its group to reorder it; drop it outside the group to move the whole group.
prefs.ui.group_tabs.label: Group worktree tabs
prefs.ui.highlight_rows.check: Light up a branch's commits while the pointer is on its label in the graph
prefs.ui.highlight_rows.label: Trace a branch on hover
prefs.ui.left_panel.label: Left panel
prefs.ui.long_date_format.label: Long date format
prefs.ui.menu_bar.help: While the menu bar is hidden, the command palette and keyboard shortcuts still reach everything, and Show menu bar in the palette brings it back.
prefs.ui.menu_bar.label: Menu bar
prefs.ui.notifications.label: Notification location
prefs.ui.relative_dates.check: Show "3 hours ago" instead of the date and time format
prefs.ui.relative_dates.label: Relative dates in graph
prefs.ui.spellcheck.help: Underlines misspellings in the commit summary and description; right-click for suggestions. Uses the Windows spell checker in your system language.
prefs.ui.spellcheck.label: Spell checking
prefs.ui.theme.files.label: Theme file
prefs.ui.theme.files.pinned: Stays open while a theme file is in use.
prefs.ui.theme.group.dark.when: used when the system is dark
prefs.ui.theme.group.light.when: used when the system is light
prefs.ui.theme.help: A theme file is a JSON file in the themes folder that changes the colors of a built-in theme. Create from current writes one to start from.
prefs.ui.theme.hint.dark: Indigo dusk under a lantern-gold accent, from the app icon.
prefs.ui.theme.hint.graphite: Near-neutral graphite greys with a cobalt accent. The default dark theme.
prefs.ui.theme.hint.high_contrast_dark: White on black with brighter colors, for the most contrast.
prefs.ui.theme.hint.high_contrast_light: Black on white with deeper colors, for the most contrast.
prefs.ui.theme.hint.light: Lavender-white paper, indigo ink and an iris accent.
prefs.ui.theme.hint.midnight: Deep blue-black with a cool sea-glass accent, for late nights.
prefs.ui.theme.hint.mist: Cool fog-grey paper and deep sea glass: Midnight's light twin.
prefs.ui.theme.hint.porcelain: Neutral white, grey-black ink and a cobalt accent. The default light theme.
prefs.ui.theme.label: Theme
prefs.ui.theme.not_in_folder: {file} is not in the themes folder; showing {theme}.
prefs.ui.theme.retired.toast: {old} is no longer included; Glowfly now uses {new}.
prefs.ui.theme.system.check: Match the system's dark or light mode
prefs.ui.title_bar.help: Shows the system's title bar and window frame instead of Glowfly's, with the tabs in their own bar below it. Takes effect when Glowfly restarts.
prefs.ui.title_bar.label: Title bar
prefs.ui.toolbar.help: While the toolbar is hidden, the status bar has a Show toolbar button, and the command palette and keyboard shortcuts keep working.
prefs.ui.toolbar.label: Toolbar
prefs.ui.toolbar_labels.label: Toolbar labels
prefs.ui.worktree_wips.check: Show other worktrees' changes in the graph
prefs.ui.worktree_wips.help: Adds a row above a worktree's checked-out commit while it has uncommitted changes, with counts. Click it to open that worktree. Counts are read when the repository loads.
prefs.ui.worktree_wips.label: Worktree changes
prefs.unsaved.body: {page} has changes that aren't saved yet.
prefs.unsaved.title: Save your changes?
